core.label: 核心功能
core.intent: Mechanism-level invariants and main-path bug regressions: lifecycle and durable state, model and multi-CLI routing, worktree isolation and sync, task separation and stages, reliable delivery, and security boundaries. UI presentation is excluded.

flow.label: 影响流程
flow.intent: Installation, upgrade, release, cross-process integration, end-to-end wiring, and behavior-level UI workflows.

other.label: 其他
other.intent: Presentation-only UI, optional integrations, performance probes, and live/manual diagnostics.

lanes.deterministic: Hermetic Node test runnable without a live MultiCC service.
lanes.isolated: Starts isolated processes, servers, repositories, or data roots.
lanes.cdp: Requires headless Chrome/CDP; a missing browser must not count as coverage.
lanes.live: Requires live services, providers, devices, credentials, or timing-sensitive benchmarks.
lanes.smoke: Exercises a running MultiCC service and may create temporary product state.
lanes.flutter: Runs under flutter test without a simulator or device.
lanes.device: Requires a booted Flutter device/simulator and a running service.
